# Branch Circuit Schedule and Layout Plan: Highland Bakery Expansion
Tenant Improvement Plan: Unit 104

## Project Scope
- General Contractor: Highland Construction Group
- Lead Electrician: Brandon Moreau
- Electrical Reviewer: Rosa Bishop, PE
- Primary Panel: Panel DP (120/208V, 3-phase, 4-wire, 225A MCB)
- Feed Point: Subpanel feeding rear kitchen prep area

## Connected Kitchen Loads
| Equipment Tag | Description | Voltage | Phase | Connected VA |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| CK-1 | Deck Oven | 208V | 3-ph | 9,600 |
| CK-2 | Spiral Dough Mixer | 208V | 3-ph | 2,800 |
| CK-3 | Proofer Cabinet | 120V | 1-ph | 1,800 |
| CK-4 | Reach-In Cooler | 120V | 1-ph | 1,200 |
| CK-5 | Exhaust Hood Fan | 208V | 3-ph | 1,600 |

## Branch Circuit Calculations and Feeders
- The combined connected load for kitchen equipment CK-1 through CK-5 is 16,000 VA before demand factors are applied.
- Dedicated branch circuit for CK-1 deck oven requires 3-pole 35A breaker protected with 8 AWG THHN copper conductors.
- Branch circuit for CK-3 proofer cabinet requires 1-pole 20A breaker with 12 AWG THHN copper conductors in 3/4-inch EMT.
- Dedicated branch circuit for CK-4 reach-in cooler requires 1-pole 15A breaker with 14 AWG THHN copper conductors.

## Layout and Rough-In Notes
- Route 1-inch EMT from Panel DP to junction box JB-2 mounted at 10 ft AFF above prep counter.
- Provide quad convenience receptacles above prep sink counters; install standard non-GFCI 20A duplex receptacles within 2 ft of sink basin perimeter.
- Branch homerun for mixer CK-2 will be installed by apprentice wireman Victor Tran on 10/14/2026.
- Maximum voltage drop design target from Panel DP to farthest appliance receptacle is 3 percent.

errors.quote: CK-1 through CK-5 is 16,000 VA before demand factors
errors.explanation: Summing the connected VA loads from the table gives 9,600 + 2,800 + 1,800 + 1,200 + 1,600 = 17,000 VA, not 16,000 VA.
errors.fix: CK-1 through CK-5 is 17,000 VA before demand factors

errors.explanation: At 208V 3-phase, a 9,600 VA load draws 26.6A (9600 / (208 * 1.732)). Under continuous duty rules (125%), minimum circuit ampacity is 33.3A, but 8 AWG THHN copper rated at 75°C is good for 50A and requires a standard 40A or 50A breaker, while a 35A breaker provides inadequate continuous headroom for a 26.6A continuous heating load.

errors.quote: install standard non-GFCI 20A duplex receptacles within 2 ft of sink basin perimeter
errors.explanation: NEC 210.8(B) requires all commercial kitchen receptacles, and specifically any receptacle within 6 feet of the top inside edge of the bowl of a sink, to have GFCI protection.
errors.fix: install GFCI-protected 20A duplex receptacles within 2 ft of sink basin perimeter
